sources.fullCitation: Stiftung Deutsche Kinemathek – Museum für Film und Fernsehen, Sammlung Paul Kohner Agency. “Spendenliste von Mitgliedern des European Film Fund zwischen dem 1. Mai 1941 und dem 30. April 1942.” Typescript list of 69 members and their donations; entries include “Kaper, Bronislaw” ($120) and “Kohner, Paul” ($213). Presented in Künste im Exil, Deutsche Nationalbibliothek.
sources.title: European Film Fund donor list, 1 May 1941–30 April 1942
sources.creator: European Film Fund
sources.repository: Stiftung Deutsche Kinemathek – Museum für Film und Fernsehen, Sammlung Paul Kohner Agency
sources.researchNote: The reproduced heading gives donations from members for 1 May 1941 to 30 April 1942. These are the dates covered by the list, not a separately established creation date. The visible first sheet includes Kaper at $120 and Kohner at $213 and ends with a carried-forward total; the institutional extended description identifies an alphabetical list of 69 people. No document-creation date is inferred from the reporting period.
